enchantments.tooltip: Hide +15: Passive: +15 Competence bonus to the Hide skill.
Move Silently +15: Passive: +15 Competence bonus to the Move Silently skill.

Invisibility Guard: This item has a chance of granting you temporary invisibility when you are hit by foes. The invisibility will not be removed when you attack or take damage, but it will wear off after 10 seconds.

Sneak Attack Bonus +5 : Provides a +5 Enhancement modifier to your attack bonus and a +8 Enhancement bonus to damage for any attack that would qualify as a Sneak Attack, even if the wielder is not a Rogue.
Mythic Cloak Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
